chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad narrated from Abdullah ibn Aamir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Hamza, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'With what should I recite in the Fajr prayer on the day of Friday?' He said: 'Recite in the first [rak'ah] Surah Al-Jumu'ah, and in the second Surah Al-Ikhlas (Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad), then perform Qunut until they both become equal [in length/duration].'

key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad (Surah Al-Ikhlas, Chapter 112)

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in the Fajr prayer on Friday according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the specific Sunnah of reciting Surah Al-Jumu'ah and Surah Al-Ikhlas during the two rak'ahs of Fajr on Friday, a practice emphasized by the Imams to honor the day. The instruction to perform Qunut until the recitations are equal in duration underscores the importance of balanced devotion and contemplation during these prayers. This ruling is often cited in Shia jurisprudence to establish the recommended (mustahabb) nature of these specific recitations for Friday mornings.
